title: Zesty Morning Tunisian Eggs Frittata
description: A savory, flaky, hangover-cure Tunisian dish featuring egg wash and bhuna. Perfect for a weekend brunch.

ingredients.name: 2 medium Onions
ingredients.notes: Yellow or white onions are fine.

ingredients.name: 2 Garlic Cloves
ingredients.notes: Minced or crushed garlic is good.

ingredients.name: 1/2 cup Bhuna Paste
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought, whichever you prefer.

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup Grated Feta Cheese (optional)
ingredients.notes: Dairy or vegan cheese, whichever you prefer.

ingredients.name: Fresh Parsley
ingredients.notes: Chopped parsley is nice for garnish.

instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together eggs, flour, salt, and pepper.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are translucent.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the bhuna paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and cook until wilted.
Pour the egg mixture over the spinach mixture and cook, stirring occasionally, until the eggs are almost set.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes or until the eggs are fully set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Use a spatula to loosen the edges of the frittata and slide it onto a plate.
Garnish with parsley and feta cheese, if using.
